properties.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued September 16 at 11:23AM MST until September 16 at 2:30PM MST by NWS Flagstaff AZ
properties.description:
FFWFGZ

The National Weather Service in Flagstaff has issued a

* Flash Flood Warning for...
The Labyrinth Canyon and Pace Canyon watersheds in...
Coconino County in north central Arizona...

* Until 230 PM MST /330 PM MDT/.

* At 1123 AM MST /1223 PM MDT/, Doppler radar indicated thunderstorms
producing heavy rain over the Labyrinth Canyon and Face Canyon
watersheds. Up to 1.5 inches of rain have fallen. Flash flooding is
ongoing or expected to begin shortly.

HAZARD...Life threatening flash flooding. Thunderstorms producing
flash flooding in and around the Labyrinth Canyon and Face
Canyon watersheds.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Life threatening flash flooding of areas in and around the
Labyrinth Canyon and Face Canyon watersheds.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Labyrinth Canyon, Tower Butte and Wild Horse Mesa.

This includes the following slot canyons...
Labyrinth Canyon and Face Canyon.

This includes the following creeks, washes and rivers...
West Canyon Creek.
properties.instruction:
Get out of Labyrinth Canyon immediately! Deadly flash flooding is
imminent or occurring.

Move any beached boats away from the mouth of Labyrinth Canyon
immediately! Violent flood waters will drain into Lake Powell at this
location.

properties.description:

Southern Adams County in northeastern Indiana...
Southeast Huntington County in northeastern Indiana...
Wells County in northeastern Indiana...

and flood-prone locations is imminent or occurring.

Counties.

tonight. It will then fall below flood stage tomorrow morning.
